Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console

package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console
Petstore admin console: the /console page tree.

Every page is a FreeMarker template rendered inside the base.ftlh console chrome, mounted beside the unchanged /petstore API and sharing its PetStore.

Example:

@Rest(children={PetStoreResource.class, PetstoreConsoleResource.class}) public class RootResources extends BasicRestServletGroup {}
